name: Zephaniah
overview: Zephaniah is a male biblical figure identified as the father of Josiah, as referenced in Zechariah 6:10. His tribal affiliation and surname are not recorded in Scripture. There is a possibility that he is the same individual as the prophet Zephaniah, though this is not definitively established.
namesAndTitles: The name Zephaniah means 'YHWH has hidden' or 'YHWH has hidden as a treasure,' reflecting a divine attribute of protection or preservation. This proper name is noted in Zechariah 6:10 and is not indicated to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Zephaniah as the father of Josiah, based on an inference from Zechariah 6:10. Beyond this, no additional family relationships or tribal lineage are documented for him.
scriptureSignificance: Zephaniah's significance lies primarily in his role as the father of Josiah, a key figure in biblical history. The possibility that he is the same as the prophet Zephaniah adds a layer of interest, suggesting a connection to prophetic ministry. His mention in Zechariah 6:10 situates him within the biblical narrative as part of God's unfolding plan, though specific details about his life and ministry remain limited.
